page.noRun: No plan run at this site yet
page.noSites: This company has no site you plan at.

live.offline: Offline: the queue is not updated by itself

noAccess.title: Exceptions are not open to your role
noAccess.body: Your role cannot read the plan (planning.view). Ask an administrator if you need it.

keys.acknowledge: Acknowledge the ticked rows (else the focused one)
keys.resolve: Resolve the focused row with a note
keys.walk: Previous / next exception in the detail

held.noRun: Your role cannot run the plan (planning.run).
held.running: A run is going: two runs never overlap.
held.noManage: Your role cannot work the exceptions (planning.exceptions.manage).
held.resolvedRow: Resolved: nothing is left to do with it.
held.noneNew: None of the ticked rows is new.

hint.new: found by a run, nobody has taken them
hint.mine: open, with you as their owner
hint.snoozedToday: come back before the day ends

error.title: Couldn’t load exceptions
error.failed: The answer did not come. Try again in a moment.
error.forbidden: Your role cannot read the plan of this site.
error.offline: No connection to the factory server.
error.gone: This exception no longer exists here.
error.noSite: There is no site to plan in this company.

noMatch.title: No exception matches
noMatch.body: Change the search, the type or the rows shown.

clear.title: Nothing the plan could not solve. Well done.
clear.body: Every exception of the last run is acknowledged, snoozed or resolved.

empty.noRun: Run the plan once: each run lists what it could not solve here.

notice.acknowledged_one: {count} exception acknowledged: you own it now if nobody did.
notice.acknowledged_other: {count} exceptions acknowledged: you own the ones nobody owned.
notice.snoozed: Snoozed until {date}: it comes back by itself.
notice.snoozedRun: Snoozed until the next run: it comes back when the plan runs again.
notice.resolved: Resolved with your note. If a later run finds it again, it comes back as a new occurrence.
notice.ran: The plan was run again: the queue shows what it could not solve.
notice.runBusy: A run is already going for this site: wait for it to finish.

refusal.failed: The change was not saved. Try again.
refusal.resolved: It was resolved meanwhile: nothing changed.
refusal.acknowledged: Someone acknowledged it meanwhile: nothing changed.
refusal.changed: It changed since you read it (a run or a colleague): the queue was read again.
refusal.until: Snooze until a later moment, or until the next run.
refusal.note: The note must be 3 to 1000 characters.
refusal.sites: Acknowledge the exceptions of one site at a time.
refusal.invalid: The request was not valid: nothing changed.
refusal.forbidden: Your role cannot work this exception.
refusal.gone: This exception no longer exists here.

SHORT.buy: {material}: {quantity} short for {who}, needed {date}; nothing is ordered for it yet.
SHORT.make: {material}: {quantity} short for {who}, needed {date}; nothing is planned to make it yet.
SHORT.late_one: Ordered today it arrives {count} day late.
SHORT.late_other: Ordered today it arrives {count} days late.

SUPPLY_LATE.late_one: {material}: {po} arrives {date}; it is needed {need} ({count} day late).
SUPPLY_LATE.late_other: {material}: {po} arrives {date}; it is needed {need} ({count} days late).
SUPPLY_LATE.overdue: {material}: {po} was due {date} and {quantity} of it has not come yet.

s.PAST_DUE_one: {order} line {seq} was due {date} ({count} day ago) and still needs material.
s.PAST_DUE_other: {order} line {seq} was due {date} ({count} days ago) and still needs material.

EXCESS.po: {material}: {quantity} of {po} is more than the orders need.
EXCESS.firm: {material}: {quantity} of the firm planned order is more than the orders need.

CANCEL.po: {material}: no order needs the {quantity} of {po} any more.
CANCEL.firm: {material}: no order needs the firm planned order ({quantity}) any more.

s.MOVE_EARLIER_one: {material}: the firm planned order is dated {date}; {quantity} of it is needed from {need}. Move it {count} day earlier.
s.MOVE_EARLIER_other: {material}: the firm planned order is dated {date}; {quantity} of it is needed from {need}. Move it {count} days earlier.
s.BELOW_SAFETY_STOCK: {material}: the stock falls to {projected} on {date}, below its safety stock of {safety}.
s.NEGATIVE_STOCK: {material}: {quantity} more is reserved than the usable stock holds (a receipt not posted, or stock moved since).
s.LANE_OVERLOADED: {lane} is booked {pct}% from {from} to {to} ({booked} of {available} min).

title.lateOrders_one: {count} order will be up to {days} days late
title.lateOrders_other: {count} orders will be up to {days} days late

fix.buy: Buy it: the line in What to buy & make
fix.make: Plan it: the line in What to buy & make
fix.elsewhere: Buy elsewhere: the line in What to buy & make
fix.reduceLine: Change or close short the line on {number}
fix.firmLine: The firm planned order: the line in What to buy & make
fix.moveFirm: Move the firm planned order earlier: the line in What to buy & make
fix.line: The line in What to buy & make

detail.first: This is the first exception of the list.
detail.last: This is the last exception of the list.
detail.cleared: Cleared: a later run no longer found it.
detail.snoozedUntil: Snoozed until {time}: it comes back by itself.
detail.chainLater: The whole chain of causes, step by step to the supplier, comes in a later wave.
detail.noFix: No record to open for this one: resolve it with a note once it is handled.
detail.fixHint: Each fix opens its record; ⌘-click keeps this queue open.

resolve.title: Resolve with a note
resolve.body: Say what was done. If a later run finds it again, it comes back as a new occurrence.
